name: XDKNet 2.5.15
body:
Android TV 2.5.15, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.14 (Emby 2.0.5.14).
Update the plugin too for TMDB reviews and cast links, the next-episode date
and parental limits on requests; everything else works with 2.1.0.13.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release is for everyone. Nothing in it needs admin rights.

## Looks

- **Pick a look in one press.** Settings > Personalization > Look shows
  Netflix style, Apple TV style, Prime Video style and XDKNet, each as a live
  preview of your own Home. Apply one, keep changing any setting afterwards,
  or press Undo to go back. Customize this look lists every setting a look
  sets and marks the ones you have changed. Looks inspired by these services.
  XDKNet is not affiliated with Netflix, Apple or Amazon.
- New users can choose a look as the first step of setup, and a new install
  opens Home on Continue Watching.
- New settings the looks use, each also there on its own: a focus outline and
  zoom, card names under posters, wide landscape cards, hero height with Play
  and More info, a pinned side menu, a menu bar that turns solid as you
  scroll, and a **Top 10** row. Classic rows can share one card shape, and
  the media bar's tint and trailer switches are now in Media Bar settings.

## Watching

- An **Episodes** button in the player lists the season so you can jump to
  another episode without leaving.
- Seek previews now work on Emby too, and chapters show on the seek bar.
- **Two subtitles at once**: pick a second subtitle in Audio & Subtitles.
- When the server has to convert a title, the player says why in plain words.
- Auto quality now measures your connection instead of guessing.
- OK on a Continue Watching card plays it straight away, and card menus
  offer Play.
- Up from the seek bar goes to Skip Intro or Skip Credits while it shows.
- A trailer picker when a title has several trailers, and separate volumes
  for trailers and previews.

## Live TV

- Record a whole series from the guide, or record from the live player.
- A channel that stalls reconnects by itself, then offers Retry.

## Downloads

- **Smart downloads** keep the next episodes of a show ready and can remove
  what you have watched.
- Skip Intro and Skip Credits work on downloaded episodes.
- Play from Server on a downloaded title.

## Details pages

- The next episode's air date for a continuing show, TMDB reviews, and links
  from cast and crew (needs the updated server plugin).

## For families

- **Kids Mode**: a simple Home with only the libraries you choose, locked
  with your PIN.
- Requests and the outside rows now keep to each user's parental rating
  (needs the updated server plugin).

## Your phone as a remote

- The phone app's remote now has a D-pad, Back, Home and search typing for
  the TV.
- Sign in on the TV by scanning a QR code with your phone.

## Fixes

- An episode that has just started no longer takes the last one's end
  position, so it is not marked watched by mistake.
- Continue Watching and Next Up keep filling past titles you have hidden.
- Your audio and subtitle picks stick on the details page; the file's own
  default audio wins over English; German and French tracks match either
  language code; a "Forced" track is no longer taken as full subtitles.
- Max Resolution now applies to VP9, VP8, MPEG-2 and MPEG-4.
- "Still watching?" answers to your remote; controls hide after a slow start.
- Two causes of the app freezing on long subtitle files and volume boost are
  gone; a title paused through the screensaver resumes instead of failing.
- Subtitle lines with the same timestamp no longer overlap.
- VC-1 plays directly on TVs that report it as video/VC1.
- With refresh rate switching on, the next episode no longer makes the TV
  renegotiate HDMI.
- A recording still in progress plays; a live channel gives its tuner back
  when it falls back to converting.
- Converted downloads keep your audio track and can be seeked.
- Requests: ask for more seasons of a show that is still running.
- Wrong PIN guesses make you wait after the first few.
